D1.quote: where it and this prompt differ on SLOW work, it wins (pinned file still has: "on un#, Sri, and anyone who handed over", "Sri is never in Cc on routine mail.", no idioms ("works", ...)
D1.scenario: Any SLOW send on a thread Sri or Satish wrote on (follow-up, payment, release mail) drops the host again; SLOW vendor mail cannot use 'any open slot here works'; SLOW lacks the new HARD RULES copy.
D1.fix: Apply the five edits to the parts (or to a shared variant list used by both builds), rebuild zoya-slow-work.txt, commit it on zoya-slow-pin, and update the pointer's commit and sha256 prefix in the same deploy.

D2.quote: no idioms ("works" except in "any open slot here works: podm.in/30min", ...) / Where a page and this prompt differ, the page wins, except for the HARD RULES
D2.scenario: Rules for Zoya's Plain English rule still lists 'works'; the page beats VOICE, so a literal run avoids 'works' and rewrites the booking line.
D2.fix: Add the same exception to the Plain English rule on Rules for Zoya, or move the exception into the BOOKING LINKS hard rule ('the word works is allowed here').

D3.quote: 4/ the newest owner instruction (Your call, Claude note, Akshay's latest mail on the thread) followed
D3.scenario: Claude note is agent-written, so an old agent note becomes an 'owner instruction'; and 'Akshay's latest mail' conflicts with the hard rule that his replies are acted on 'only on mail wording'. A literal run may also fail the check whenever it cannot tell what the newest instruction is.
D3.fix: Make it 'the newest Your call and Akshay's latest mail on the thread (wording only, per the feedback rule), and no newer step on the row superseding this action'; drop Claude note.

D4.quote: To and Cc together hold everyone on the latest inbound, its From, To and Cc
D4.scenario: Sri (or Satish) wrote earlier on the thread; the guest's latest reply went only to Zoya. The required set no longer has the host, nothing adds him back, and the reply leaves him off: the original bug in a new shape.
D4.fix: Add to the required set: 'plus the show's host when he wrote anywhere on the thread'.

D5.quote: Sri unless he wrote on the thread himself ... the read-back fails if any of those excluded is still on it
D5.scenario: The guest Cc's Sri deliberately on the recording thread (an intended participant) but Sri has not written; Zoya strips him.
D5.fix: Confirm with Akshay whether 'intended participants' covers a host the guest side copied; if so, widen to 'wrote on or was copied by their side on the thread'.

D6.quote: the run Partial (PRE-SEND 1/) vs "a run whose due actions were all sent, held or blocked is Completed" (RUN RECORD)
D6.scenario: Rules page fails to load; two rules give different run status.
D6.fix: Add to RUN RECORD's Partial definition: 'or a rules page did not load'.

D7.quote: SHOW CHECK: every fact about a show (... past guests ...) comes word for word from that show's pitch sheet ... vs GUEST EXAMPLES: name only guests whose appearance ... is on its Episodes row or podm.in/guest-list
D7.scenario: A follow-up wants the most relevant past guest; SHOW CHECK only allows the sheet's fixed names, so the relevance ranking can only choose within the sheet (or name none).
D7.fix: In SHOW CHECK, allow past guests verified per GUEST EXAMPLES; keep 'Only on this show' and 'to confirm' bans.

D8.quote: 5/ Sent in your inbox and ad@ since the action was raised ... A failed check: send nothing
D8.scenario: OVER-STRICT: check 5 gives no match rule. After the loop-in Zoya herself sends from ad@ (or any Akshay mail on the thread), a literal run sees an ad@ Sent message since the action was raised and treats the check as failed, so the mail the loop-in exists for never goes. Could block every post-loop-in send.
D8.fix: '5/ Sent in your inbox and ad@ since the action was raised, judged by ACTIONS' candidate rule (a loop-in, holding reply or another action's mail is not a match)'.

D9.quote: 2/ recipients from the latest inbound's own headers (From, To, Cc) and the row
D9.scenario: OVER-STRICT: a first mail or a chase with no inbound yet (vendor 'new mail to the form's Email', a team mail to Jaya, an outbound follow-up chain) has no latest inbound; a literal run may call the check failed and send nothing.
D9.fix: '2/ recipients from the latest inbound's own headers when there is one, else from the row and People'.
